title: Jagged Smoky Irish Lamb Skewers
description: A smoky and dense Irish dish featuring lamb skewers, perfect for a weeknight dinner, with a hint of rice vinegar and a low-carb friendly profile.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, rice vinegar, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the lamb reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
Serve with a side of roasted vegetables or a salad for a low-carb friendly meal.
